resources.string: Transaction Information: Details of fare transactions, including origin and destination stations, fare amounts, transaction dates, payment status, and transaction references.

Payment Information: Payment status and transaction references associated with supported payment providers. Sensitive payment credentials are handled according to the provider\'s policies and are not intentionally stored by RailTap unless explicitly required and securely implemented.
QR Code and NFC Information: Data associated with generating, processing, or validating QR codes and NFC-based transactions.
Device and Technical Information: Basic device, application, and diagnostic information needed to operate, troubleshoot, and improve the application.
Contact Information: Information you voluntarily provide when contacting us for support or inquiries.
